column3: **Title:** Q & A's FOR THE PMBOK® GUIDE FOURTH EDITION  **Subtitle:** Questions (Chapter 1 of the PMBOK® Guide)  ---  **Section Heading:** Introduction   *(Chapter 1 of the PMBOK® Guide)*    A. A project is:    - **A set of sequential activities performed in a process or system.**    - **B. A revenue-generating activity that needs to be accomplished while achieving customer satisfaction.**    - **C. An ongoing endeavor undertaken to meet customer or market requirements.**    - **D. A temporary endeavor undertaken to create a unique product, service, or result.**  ---  **Section Heading:** Project management is: A. The integration of the critical path method and the Earned Value Management system. B. The application of knowledge, skills, tools, and techniques to project activities to meet project requirements. C. The application of knowledge, skills, wisdom, science, and art to organizational activities to achieve operational excellence. D. A subset of most engineering and other technical disciplines.  ---  **Footer:** Q & As for the PMBOK® Guide Questions   1
